LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 WORD CLASSES: VERB ASPECT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect, part of Strand 12 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do we show the time if an action has just taken place? 2. How do we show that an action has been completed?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. respond to questions on activities they have just completed depicting the present and past perfect aspects with peers,

2. identify present perfect and past perfect aspect in sentences,

3. use games to form sentences in the present perfect and past perfect aspect with given verbs,

4. repeat sentences containing present perfect and past perfect aspect from a story or poem heard,

5. create a list of sentences in the present perfect and past perfect aspect on a computer or tablet, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. respond to questions on activities they have just completed depicting the present and past perfect aspects with peers,
2. identify present perfect and past perfect aspect in sentences,
3. use games to form sentences in the present perfect and past perfect aspect with given verbs,
4. repeat sentences containing present perfect and past perfect aspect from a story or poem heard,
5. create a list of sentences in the present perfect and past perfect aspect on a computer or tablet, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner engages in responding to questions on activities they have just

completed collaboratively with peers.

• Self-efficacy: This is developed when the learner confidently makes correct sentences while creating a list of sentences

in present and past perfect aspect.

Values:
Love: This is nurtured as the learner puts the interest of others before own interest when engaging in language games

featuring sentences in present and past perfect aspect.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Effective Communication Skills: These skills are perfected as the learner uses the present and past perfect aspects correctly

in sentences and learns how to communicate with clarity.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can apply the knowledge of present and past perfect aspect in learning similar concepts in Kiswahili.
